sources.summary: Domus Academy opens the Call for Participation for UNFOLD 2027, the fourth edition of its international project competition for design schools and institutions, taking place during Milan Design Week, 12–18 April 2027. Following an edition that brought together 20 universities from around the world, UNFOLD returns to connect international design students and educators through an exhibition and one-day conference.
